reason: Both conversations wrongly treat a momentary burning-rubber smell from a belt jam as a fire risk requiring a 'qualified engineer', which the ground truth lists as an unsupported escalation. Conversation 1 at least identifies the correct likely cause (snapped/melted drive belt from hair wrapped round the roller) and offers power-off checks of the floorhead and belt, pointing towards the right direction. Conversation 2 is pure boilerplate with no diagnosis, no questions and no next step, so it serves the homeowner clearly worse.
